"""Synthetic rule boundaries and causal prefix regressions; no market data."""

import pandas as pd
import pytest
from pydantic import ValidationError

from quant_lab.config import StrategyConfig
from quant_lab.strategies.manual_engulfing_breakout_v1 import (
    ManualEngulfingBreakoutV1Strategy,
    Parameters,
)
from quant_lab.strategies.registry import StrategyRegistry


def strategy():
    return ManualEngulfingBreakoutV1Strategy(
        StrategyConfig(name="manual_engulfing_breakout_v1", enabled=True)
    )


def candles():
    frame = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "timestamp": pd.date_range("2022-01-01", periods=110, freq="h", tz="UTC"),
            "open": 10.0,
            "high": 12.0,
            "low": 8.0,
            "close": 9.0,
            "volume": 1.0,
        }
    )
    frame.loc[100, ["close", "high"]] = [13.0, 14.0]
    frame.loc[101, "close"] = 7.0
    return frame


def test_contract():
    registry = StrategyRegistry().discover()
    assert registry.implementation(strategy().name) is ManualEngulfingBreakoutV1Strategy
    assert strategy().lab_modes == ("LONG_ONLY",)
    assert strategy().required_warmup({}, "1h") == 100
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        Parameters.model_validate({"unexpected": 1})
    signals = strategy().generate_signals(candles())
    assert signals.long_entries[100]
    assert signals.long_exits[101]
    assert not any(signals.long_entries[:100])
    assert not any(signals.long_exits[:100])
    assert not any(signals.short_entries + signals.short_exits)
    assert all(type(v) is bool for v in signals.long_entries + signals.long_exits)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "row,column,value",
    [
        (100, "close", 12.0),
        (100, "open", 13.0),
        (99, "close", 10.0),
        (99, "high", float("nan")),
        (100, "close", float("nan")),
    ],
)
def test_entry_rejections(row, column, value):
    frame = candles()
    frame.loc[row, column] = value
    assert not strategy().generate_signals(frame).long_entries[100]


def test_exit_equality_and_nan():
    for value in (8.0, float("nan")):
        frame = candles()
        frame.loc[101, "close"] = value
        assert not strategy().generate_signals(frame).long_exits[101]


def test_gaps_block_both_signals():
    for row, field in ((100, "long_entries"), (101, "long_exits")):
        frame = candles()
        frame.loc[row:, "timestamp"] += pd.Timedelta(hours=1)
        assert not getattr(strategy().generate_signals(frame), field)[row]


def test_warmup_and_prefix_invariance():
    frame = candles()
    frame.loc[98, ["close", "high"]] = [13.0, 14.0]
    frame.loc[99, "close"] = 7.0
    original = frame.copy(deep=True)
    full = strategy().prepare_features(frame)
    signals = strategy().generate_signals(frame)
    assert not any(signals.long_entries[:100] + signals.long_exits[:100])
    for end in (1, 99, 100, 101, 102, 110):
        prefix = frame.iloc[:end]
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(strategy().prepare_features(prefix), full.iloc[:end])
        partial = strategy().generate_signals(prefix)
        for field in ("long_entries", "long_exits", "short_entries", "short_exits"):
            assert getattr(partial, field) == getattr(signals, field)[:end]
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(frame, original)
